report_name: CISA Adds Actively Exploited Cisco and Acronis Flaws to KEV Catalog

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-76460
vulnerabilities.description: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) that is being actively exploited. CISA added this flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, mandating remediation by U.S. federal agencies by September 19, 2026.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-87886
vulnerabilities.description: An incorrect default permissions vulnerability in Acronis Backup that is being actively exploited. CISA added this flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, mandating remediation by U.S. federal agencies by October 7, 2026.

identities.name: Federal Civilian Executive Branch
identities.description: A branch of U.S. federal agencies mandated by CISA's Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04 to remediate CVE-2026-76460 and CVE-2026-87886 due to active exploitation.
